content.tagline: Care for dehydrated skin — cactus, peptides and a simple layered routine
content.descriptor: BEAUTYBLVD, the company behind DESERT FREE: one sunscreen and three Cactide serums
about: BEAUTYBLVD was founded in 2020 and introduced DESERT FREE in May 2024. The company reports that its CEO has around 30 years of experience in cosmetics.
The brand's philosophy, The Earth is Skin, connects skincare with the environment around us. DESERT FREE focuses on dry and dehydrated skin and the effects of climatic factors on everyday care.

Less, but Essential expresses the brand's approach to a simple routine. Easy-Step Skincare brings together a first serum-toner, targeted serums and sun care, with attention to textures that can be layered.
The Cactide range combines the concepts of cactus and peptide across four products: Barrier Sun Cream, Double Repair Serum, Aquagel First Serum and Glow C Serum.

lines.name: Cactide Barrier Sun Cream
lines.note: A 50 ml sunscreen with SPF50+ PA++++. The formula combines cactus extract and beta-glucan in a light, watery serum-like texture.

lines.name: Cactide Double Repair Serum
lines.note: This 50 ml serum has a viscous texture and contains cactus, ectoin, Peptide-12 and fermented plant-derived squalane.

lines.name: Cactide Aquagel First Serum
lines.note: A 130 ml serum-toner with a jelly-like texture, designed as the first step in the routine.

lines.name: Cactide Glow C Serum
lines.note: A 50 ml serum with vitamin C, Vita-Peptide and 2% niacinamide in a milky texture. Launch: September 2025.

tech.name: Cactide
tech.note: Cactide combines cactus + peptide. This ingredient concept connects the four products in the DESERT FREE range.

tech.name: Less, but Essential / Easy-Step Skincare
tech.note: A simple routine built around a first serum-toner, targeted serums and sun care. The brand places the emphasis on essential steps and textures suited to layering.

content.exportNote: According to BEAUTYBLVD, Double Repair Serum, Aquagel First Serum and Glow C Serum were notified through CPNP and listed under MoCRA.
